day_local: Sabtida Toddobaadkii Labaatan iyo Sagaalaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso. Masiixow, noo naxariiso. Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Aynu ugu faraxsanahay inaan tagno guriga Rabbiga.
homily:
Mararka qaarkood, nolosheennu waxay u egtahay beero la beeray oo sugaysa xilli-roobaad. Waxaad arki kartaa geed berde ah oo taagan, oo caleemihiisu ay quruxsan yihiin, laakiin marka aad si dhow u eegto laamihiisa, waxaad arkaysaa inaysan midho lahayn. Waxaan maanta ka bilaabaynaa sawirkan: geedka berdeha ee beerta ku yaalla. Waxaynu nahay dad jecel inay wax arkaan, dad jecel inay natiijooyin u jeedaan. Waxaan rabnaa inaan aragno midho, waxaan rabnaa inaan aragno guul, waxaan rabnaa inaan aragno nolol u socota si habsami leh. Laakiin nolosha dhabta ah, mararka qaarkood, waxay u egtahay geedkaas oo aan midho lahayn in kasta oo aanu dadaalnay.

Benjamin Vo, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu ahaa wiil leh maskax aad u fiiqan. Wuxuu ahaa wiil ku dhex noolaa dunida xawaaraha sare leh ee tiknoolajiyadda, isagoo baranaya nidaamyada AWS iyo DevOps, isagoo maskaxdiisa ku dhisaya 'con chim airlines'. Wuxuu ahaa wiil had iyo jeer raadinaya inuu wax abuuro, inuu wax dhiso, inuu horay u socdo. Laakiin maanta, akhriska koowaad, Bawlos wuxuu inoo sheegayaa wax ka duwan waxa dunidu inoo sheegto. Wuxuu leeyahay: 'Grace was given to each of us according to the measure of Christ’s gift.' Nimcada waxaa naloo siiyay si waafaqsan qiyaasta hadiyadda Masiixa. Benjamin wuxuu ahaa hadiyad. Nolosha gaaban ee uu ku noolaa ma ahayn mid aan midho lahayn; waxay ahayd nolol buuxda oo nimco ka buuxdo, xitaa haddii aysan u ekayn sida dadka kale u arkaan.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo aad u culus. Waxaa jira daqiiqado marka aad eegtaan qolkiisa, ama marka aad xasuusataan dhoola caddayntiisa, oo aad dareemaysaan inaysan jirin wax buuxin kara booskaas. Waxaan rabaa inaan si daacad ah idiinla hadlo. Waxaad dareemi kartaan in geedka nolosha qoyskiinna uu u baahday in la gooyo, laakiin taasi ma aha runta. Ilaah ma aha kan gooya geedka. Ilaah waa kan beeralayda ah ee leh: 'Sir, leave it for this year also, and I shall cultivate the ground around it and fertilize it.' Ilaah wuxuu daryeelayaa geedkaas. Ilaah wuxuu daryeelayaa xusuusta Ben. Ilaah wuxuu daryeelayaa xanuunkaaga. Waxaan rabaa inaan si gaar ah u xuso wax ay dad badan oo waalidiin ah ku qariyaan qalbiyadooda: dareenka ah in laga yaabo inay wax qaldan sameeyeen, ama ay wax seegeen. Fadlan, ha is-eedeynin. Ilaah wuxuu ku yiri: 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna wuxuu ahaa mid aan xad lahayn. Xanuunkan ma aha khaladkiinna, mana aha ciqaab. Waa qayb ka mid ah xaqiiqada adag ee dunidan, laakiin Ilaah wuu idinla jiraa.

Bal ka feker jacaylka Ben. Xusuusnow markuu rabay inuu u huro lacagtiisa si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa dabeecadda wiilkan qalbiga wanaagsan. Taasi waa midhaha dhabta ah ee ruuxa. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil baray qoyskiisa iyo dadka kaleba inay jeclaadaan si aan shuruud lahayn. Marka aad maanta dareento cidlo, xusuuso in Ben uusan maqnayn; wuxuu ku jiraa xusuusta Ilaah, wuxuuna ku jiraa meel aanay jirin xanuun ama daal. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven', isagoo dhoola caddaynaya.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in geedka noloshaada uu weli Ilaah daryeelayo, isagoo ku daraya bacrimin iyo jacayl maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kuu jecelahay wax kasta oo kale, waxaana rabaa inaan naftayda kuugu dhiibo. Maadaama aanan hadda kuu qaadan karin Sakramental-ka, fadlan igu soo gal ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii adigoo hore u joogay, waxaana naftayda gebi ahaanba kuu dhiibayaa. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabad weligeed ah. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: U ducee Benjamin Vo iyo dhammaan dadka dhintay, si ay u nastaan iftiinka Masiixa.
U ducee dhammaan dadka murugaysan, si Ilaah u qaboojiyo qalbigooda oo uu u siiyo rajo.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal, mid kasta oo inaga mid ah waxaa la siiyay nimco sida uu Masiixu hadiyadda u cabbiray. Sidaas darteed, waxaa la yiri: 'Markuu kor u kacay, wuxuu maxaabiis u kaxeeyay maxaabiis, wuxuuna hadiyado siiyay dadka.' Maxay ka dhigan tahay 'uu kor u kacay' marka laga reebo inuu sidoo kale u soo degay gobollada hoose ee dhulka? Kii soo degay waa isla kii kor u kacay oo ka sarreeyey dhammaan samada, si uu wax walba u buuxiyo. Wuxuuna qaar ka dhigay rasuullo, qaar nebiyo, qaar injiil-sheegayaal, qaar daajiyayaal iyo macallimiin, si ay u qalabeeyaan quduusiinta shaqada adeegga, dhisidda jidhka Masiixa, ilaa aynu dhammaanteen gaarno midnimada rumaysadka iyo aqoonta Wiilka Ilaah, ilaa aynu gaarno nin weyn oo buuxa oo xadkiisu yahay qiyaasta buuxda ee Masiixa, si aynu mar dambe u noqon carruur, oo ay dabayshu iyo hirarku u qaadin, ama ayan na dhalanteedin waxbaridda dadka oo ay ku jiraan khiyaano iyo qorshe khaldan. Laakiin annagoo runta ku nool jacaylka, waa inaan ku kornaa wax kasta oo ku dhex jira isaga oo ah madaxa, Masiixa, kaas oo jidhka oo dhan, oo ay isku hayaan xididdada taageeraya, qayb kastaana ay u shaqaynayso siday tahay, ay keento koritaanka jidhka oo ay isku dhisayso jacayl.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Aynu ugu faraxsanahay inaan tagno guriga Rabbiga. Waxaan ku farxay markay igu yiraahdeen, 'Waxaan u kici doonnaa guriga Rabbiga.' Hadda waxaan cagta saarnay iridahaaga, Yeruusaalemow. R. Aynu ugu faraxsanahay inaan tagno guriga Rabbiga. Yeruusaalem, oo loo dhisay sidii magaalo midaysan. Halkaas ayay qabiiladu u kacaan, qabiilada Rabbiga. R. Aynu ugu faraxsanahay inaan tagno guriga Rabbiga. Sida waafaqsan qaynuunka Israa'iil, si ay ugu mahadceliyaan magaca Rabbiga. Halkaas waxaa la dhigay kuraastii xukunnada, kuraastii guriga Daa'uud. R. Aynu ugu faraxsanahay inaan tagno guriga Rabbiga.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Dad baa Ciise u sheegay dadkii reer Galilea ee dhiiggooda uu Bilaatos ku daray dhiiggii qurbaannadooda. Wuxuuna ugu jawaabay, 'Ma waxaad u malaynaysaan in dadka reer Galilea ay dembiilayaal ka sii ahaa dadka kale ee reer Galilea oo dhan sababtoo ah way dhibtoodeen? Marnaba ma aha! Laakiin waxaan idin leeyahay, haddii aydun toobad keenin, dhammaantiin waad halligmi doontaan siday u halligmeen! Ama sidii siddeed iyo tobankii qof ee ku dhintay markii munaaraddii Siloam ku soo duntay – ma waxaad u malaynaysaan inay ka dambi badnaayeen dadka kale oo dhan oo Yeruusaalem ku noolaa? Marnaba ma aha! Laakiin waxaan idin leeyahay, haddii aydun toobad keenin, dhammaantiin waad halligmi doontaan siday u halligmeen!' Wuxuuna u sheegay masaalkan: 'Waxaa jiray nin beer ku lahaa geed berde ah, markuu u yimid inuu midho ka raadiyo oo uu waayay, wuxuu ku yiri beeralaygii, 'Saddex sano ayaan u imanayay inaan midho ka raadiyo geedkan berdeha ah, laakiin midna kama helin. Sidaas darteed jar. Maxay carrada u daalinaysaa?' Wuxuuna ugu jawaabay, 'Sayidow, u daa sannadkan sidoo kale, waanan beeri doonaa carrada agtiisa oo waan bacrimin doonaa; waxaa laga yaabaa inuu midho dhali doono mustaqbalka. Haddii kale waad jari kartaa.''

day: Saturday of the Twenty-ninth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
